metas.name: 2026 · Practical Magic 2
metas.description: A multi generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · It Ends
metas.description: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2026 · Pinocchio: Unstrung
metas.description: A dark coming-of-age reimagining of Pinocchio, this unsettling tale follows the iconic puppet's disturbing journey toward becoming real.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2026 · The Odyssey
metas.description: After the Trojan War, Odysseus faces a dangerous voyage back to Ithaca, meeting creatures like the Cyclops Polyphemus, Sirens, and Calypso along the way.

metas.name: ★ 9.0 · 2026 · BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity
metas.description: The Soul Reapers and Quincies clash in a final battle as Yhwach breaches the Royal Palace. When the Soul King falls, reality begins collapsing. Former enemies unite to storm the transformed palace and face a threat to all existence.
